required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Open/free source snapshot exists locally, is hash-bound, and satisfies source separation policy.

required_source.requirement: Acquire and hash NIST Chemical Kinetics Database gas-phase reaction records from https://kinetics.nist.gov/kinetics/rpSearch?cas=7732185.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Target table is locked before scoring and hidden fields do not leak into model selection.

required_target.requirement: Hide rate constants or Arrhenius parameters until predictions are materialized from visible reactant/product identifiers, temperature grid, and preregistered formula.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC prediction/scoring rule is preregistered before target unsealing.

required_model.requirement: Arrhenius or modified Arrhenius replay: k(T)=A*T^n*exp(-Ea/(R*T)) with all coefficient-use rules declared before target opening.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Incumbent comparator is scored on the same held-out targets.

required_comparator.requirement: Use preregistered shuffled or family-median Arrhenius coefficients that do not read the hidden target row.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC residual advantage exceeds preregistered materiality threshold under uncertainty.

required_uncertainty.requirement: Use source uncertainty when present; otherwise use a preregistered dex tolerance before target opening.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Negative controls and falsifiers are declared and replayed without post-hoc adjustment.

required_falsifier.requirement: target rate constants leak into visible inputs, N<20, source lock missing, residuals exceed uncertainty, or comparator is not worse
